dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Hehe, sorry, I don't look like someone who's been in the Eremites, do I?

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: But I was a veritable mercenary there! I could punch sea monsters in the face!

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Well, that was a joke. It's hard to beat a sea monster. But to deal with a couple of drunks, it's as easy as pie.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Even when there's something I can't handle, I have the gorgeous, gentle, and powerful Roshana here.

dialogues.speaker: Nesmil
dialogues.text: Anyone who annoys her will come to a bad end.
